jobs.title: Commercial Operations Executive
jobs.summary: Own our e-tendering and online bidding end to end, from document prep to live reverse auctions.
jobs.about: We are looking for a detail-oriented, tech-savvy professional to run our commercial bidding and e-tendering. Sitting in the commercial team at Tadali MIDC, you will live inside online B2B portals, build tender documents that win, and hold your nerve in live reverse auctions against India's largest power, cement, steel and defence buyers.

responsibilities.d: End-to-end preparation, compilation and on-time submission of technical and commercial bids for government and private tenders.
Register, update and maintain our company profile across client B2B portals, e-procurement sites, GeM and private vendor portals.
Run live online reverse auctions in real time, coordinating with senior management while the clock is running.
Produce accurate quotations, estimates and compliance documents that meet every client guideline exactly.
Pull technical data and pricing out of the engineering, estimating and management teams to build each bid.

mustHave: Graduate or Diploma in any stream
Exceptional attention to detail and strong numerical ability
Comfortable working to strict submission deadlines
Confident navigating complex websites and online portals
Solid with MS Office, Excel and Google Sheets
Sharp and alert under pressure, such as a live auction
niceToHave: Prior e-tendering, online bidding or vendor portal experience

benefits.d: A professional environment inside one of Central India's most respected heavy engineering groups.
Direct involvement in winning high-value industrial contracts, with a clear path up in commercial operations.
Competitive salary benchmarked to industry standards and your experience level.

jobs.title: Sales & Marketing Engineer
jobs.summary: Be the face of Ferrous in the field. Technical B2B sales across power, cement, steel and defence, pan India.
jobs.about: We are looking for an energetic, technically sound Sales & Marketing Engineer to drive our growth. Based at Tadali MIDC but on the road often, you will be the face of the company to clients in power, cement, steel and defence. This is a field role: plant visits, shop-floor conversations, and closing heavy engineering contracts, backed by the digital and offline marketing you drive yourself.

responsibilities.d: Travel to industrial sites, plants and corporate offices to pitch our fabrication, machining and reconditioning capability.
Own existing accounts. Visit regularly, find the operational pain, and propose the fix using Hardox® wear parts or EWAC reclamation.
Present to plant managers, maintenance heads and procurement teams, technically and commercially.
Run offline and digital marketing: brochures, industrial expos and a professional digital presence that pulls inbound B2B leads.
Track upcoming projects, plant shutdowns and competitor moves to position us early for vendor registrations and orders.
Work with estimating, engineering and commercial so client requirements turn into proposals that actually win.

mustHave: B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or similar
Minimum 2 years in B2B industrial sales, technical marketing or business development
Exceptional interpersonal, negotiation and communication skills
Willing to travel frequently across Central India and pan-India
Able to read technical drawings and understand heavy machinery components
niceToHave: MBA or a qualification in Sales or Marketing
Experience in heavy engineering, machinery or manufacturing
Fluent in English, Hindi and Marathi

benefits.d: A high-impact role driving the top line of a 40-year-old legacy company.
Travel allowances and performance-based incentives on top of a competitive base.
Direct exposure to top management at India's largest industrial conglomerates.
A strong engineering team behind every promise you make on the field.
Accommodation for bachelors and families can be provided on request, subject to availability.

jobs.title: Workshop Supervisor
jobs.summary: Run the shop floor across 1,70,000 sq. ft. Lead machinists and fabricators on jobs up to 15 tons.
jobs.about: We are looking for a hands-on Workshop Supervisor to lead shop-floor operations at Tadali MIDC. You will run daily activity across our 1,70,000 sq. ft. campus, on machines most workshops in India do not have: a 3.5 m vertical lathe, a 3 x 13 m CNC plasma bed, a 500 MT hydraulic press. You will direct skilled technicians and operators and make sure every component going out to a power, cement, steel or defence plant is right the first time.

responsibilities.d: Supervise daily production, fabrication, assembly and machining from raw plate to finished component.
Allocate daily work to machinists, welders and the fabrication crew, and keep the workflow clear of bottlenecks.
Hold rotary air locks, crusher rotors and mill rollers to drawing, spec and Hardox® / EWAC standards.
Coordinate routine maintenance and troubleshooting on heavy machinery to keep downtime near zero.
Enforce shop-floor safety protocol, PPE discipline and factory safety guidelines without exception.
Track project timelines with planning and commercial so we deliver on the date we committed to.

mustHave: Diploma or B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent technical certification
Minimum 3 years supervising a heavy engineering workshop, plant, fabrication yard or machinery shop
Strong grasp of mechanical drawings and precision machining tolerances
Working knowledge of MIG, TIG and ARC welding
niceToHave: Experience leading a skilled blue-collar crew under deadline pressure
Exposure to Hardox® wear parts or EWAC reclamation
Familiar with vertical lathes, CNC plasma cutting or hydraulic presses

benefits.d: A professional environment inside one of Central India's most respected heavy engineering groups.
Leadership over heavy manufacturing equipment and large-scale industrial projects.
A supportive engineering team and a shop built on technical excellence.
Accommodation for bachelors and families can be provided on request, subject to availability.
